# METEY Engineering & Consultancy

> Chartered architectural and structural engineering consultancy in Hyderabad, India, established in 2013, with a branch office in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh. METEY specialises in precast concrete, monolithic and other fast-build construction technologies, high-rise and industrial structures, and affordable (PMAY/EWS) housing across India.

- Head office: 2-4-216, Road 9A, Snehapuri Colony, New Nagole, Hyderabad 500035, Telangana
- Phone: +91 40 2414 5925
- Email: info@metey.in

## Pages

- [Home](https://metey.in/): Chartered structural engineers and architects in Hyderabad since 2013, specialising in precast, monolithic and high-rise design for projects across India.
- [The Firm](https://metey.in/firm/): Established in Hyderabad in 2013, METEY is a chartered architectural and structural engineering consultancy. Our principles, specialist capabilities and team.
- [Practice](https://metey.in/practice/): Architecture and master planning, structural design, precast and monolithic fast-build technologies, interiors, peer review and construction-stage services.
- [Projects](https://metey.in/projects/): METEY projects in six states: PMAY and EWS affordable housing, precast and monolithic housing, towers, corporate, institutional and industrial buildings.
- [Insights](https://metey.in/insights/): Technical papers by METEY on precast concrete connections, monolithic EWS housing and green building technologies for PMAY, and talks at national conferences.
- [3D Lab](https://metey.in/3d-lab/): Explore interactive building models with structural X-ray, floor separation, precast assembly, camera and lighting controls.
- [Careers](https://metey.in/careers/): Internships and careers for civil and structural engineers and architects at METEY, Hyderabad, mentored by chartered engineers on live projects.
- [Contact](https://metey.in/contact/): Contact METEY Engineering & Consultancy, New Nagole, Hyderabad: +91 40 2414 5925, info@metey.in. Send an enquiry for structural or architectural design.

## Projects

- [Technology Demonstration Housing](https://metey.in/projects/kethanakonda/): A demonstration site for affordable (EWS) housing, where seven building systems were constructed at one location.
- [Vasavi Towers](https://metey.in/projects/vasavi/): Twelve blocks on a 22-acre site, each of three basements, a stilt floor and 23 floors. Residential project by METEY, Hyderabad.
- [Jindal Corporate Tower](https://metey.in/projects/jindal/): A corporate tower built as a composite structure. Commercial and civic project by METEY, Hyderabad.
- [Sai Life Sciences](https://metey.in/projects/sai-life/): A pharmaceutical facility in Hyderabad. Industrial project by METEY, Hyderabad.
- [Nursing School, Numaligarh Refinery](https://metey.in/projects/nursing-school/): A nursing school for Numaligarh Refinery Limited. Assam. Institutional project by METEY, Hyderabad.
- [11-Storey EWS Housing](https://metey.in/projects/dundigal/): Eleven-storey housing for the economically weaker section at Dundigal, Hyderabad. Affordable housing project by METEY, Hyderabad.
- [EWS Monolithic Housing](https://metey.in/projects/ews-monolithic/): Housing for the economically weaker section, cast monolithically in aluminium formwork at sites in Andhra Pradesh and Bangalore.
- [EWS Housing, Mandadam](https://metey.in/projects/mandadam/): Affordable housing built with monolithic construction technology. Designed by METEY; developed by KMV Projects. Mandadam, Amaravati.
- [Insulated Wall Construction](https://metey.in/projects/odisha/): Insulated wall construction in Odisha. Affordable housing project by METEY, Hyderabad.
- [Goa Villas](https://metey.in/projects/goa-villas/): Villas in Goa. Residential project by METEY, Hyderabad.
- [Landcraft](https://metey.in/projects/landcraft/): Recorded during construction and after completion. Residential project by METEY, Hyderabad.
- [Conference Hall](https://metey.in/projects/conference-hall/): A conference hall at Kethanakonda. Commercial and civic project by METEY, Hyderabad.
- [Montessori School](https://metey.in/projects/montessori/): A Montessori school in Bangalore. Institutional project by METEY, Hyderabad.
- [11 MW Power Plant](https://metey.in/projects/power-plant/): Structures for an 11 MW power plant. Industrial project by METEY, Hyderabad.
